change: task contract v1 + assumption ledger: first turn read-only, list requirements and ambiguities
manual_verdict: not significant; the ambiguous-task subset effect did not replicate over 4 batches (D-050)

change: verifier_gate=self_check: before completion the model is asked to check its own work
manual_verdict: not significant; on gpt-6-sol it was -2.1 pp with turns nearly doubled (E4s)

change: verifier_gate=auditor: separate auditor call reviews the work before completion (option since removed)
cost_effects: cost +29%, timeouts 10->17 (rejections pushed 7 trials into the time limit)

change: stuck reminder + budget hint + exit-code prompt (options since removed)
manual_verdict: retired (D-039): no failure pattern behind it

change: adaptive_wait: sentinel + timeout + interactive-prompt detection instead of fixed waits
mechanism_effects: empty-wait turns -27% per trial; POLLING share of failures 13%->4%
cost_effects: input tokens -11 to -16%, turns -0.6 to -1.0, wall clock +4%
manual_verdict: the only stable gain in the project: efficiency, not pass rate
same direction as the TB efficiency gain; k=1, intervals cross zero

change: deliverable_checkpoint: at a time threshold, remind the model to write the deliverable if it does not exist
manual_verdict: mechanism works, pass rate did not go up (D-047)

change: verifier_gate=grader_check: acceptance-style self-test checklist before completion
manual_verdict: harmful under a hard time limit: extra verification turns crowd out the budget (D-047)

mechanism_effects: ambiguous tasks +7.1, clear tasks -7.4 (later not replicated)

change: task contract v2: checklist of 7 ambiguity types, forced resolutions
mechanism_effects: ledger hit the decisive detail 12/15, but passes when hit 3/12 (v1: 8/12)
manual_verdict: no effect; forcing written resolutions changed correct decisions

change: contract only when a pre-run clarity score says the task is ambiguous
cost_effects: timeouts 12->15; scoring call median 48 s inside the time limit

change: task contract on a strong model
manual_verdict: crutch test: weak model +7.7, strong model 0

change: interface_fixes: lenient JSON parsing, pre-run environment probe, continuation-prompt note
mechanism_effects: trials with format errors 57%->8% (turns per trial 2.6->0.17); turn-cap hits 9->1; command-not-found 40%->38%
manual_verdict: mechanism confirmed (format-error turns -93%); pass rate not significant

change: completion_gate on top of interface_fixes: bounce the first completion claim once if nothing ran after the last edit or the model admits failure
mechanism_effects: bounced 37/120 trials, only 4 of them passed later; echo-instead-of-check 42%->49%; false success 31%->29%
manual_verdict: pre-registered prediction falsified: the gate forces checking, the model cannot fix what it finds

change: qwen-code agent (native tool calls): a different harness, not an option of ours
manual_verdict: upper reference for interface fit; tied with H2 on pass rate

change: H2 (interface_fixes+completion_gate) vs H0 on held-out synthetic tasks, base model and SFT model
mechanism_effects: on the SFT model +2.7; interaction +3.6 [-0.9, +9.0]; format errors under H0 still 53% after training
